question: Who among the following announced the ‘Sushma Swaraj Award’ for women in the state budget in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manohar Lal Khattar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Haryana Chief Minister, Manohar Lal Khattar** introduced the **'Sushma Swaraj Award' **during the state budget presentation, honoring women for their noteworthy achievements and contributions in various fields at both national and international levels.
 
• The award, named after the late Sushma Swaraj, a former lawyer of the Supreme Court and prominent Indian politician, will carry a prize of Rs 5 lakh along with a commendation.
 
• Sushma Swaraj, a senior member of the Bharatiya Janata Party, served as India's Minister of External Affairs during the** first Narendra Modi government (2014–2019)**, becoming the second woman to hold this position after Indira Gandhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manohar Lal Khattar, **born on May 5, 1954, is an Indian politician affiliated with the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and a former Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) **pracharak.
 
• He served as the **10th Chief Minister of Haryana** since 2014 and represented the Karnal constituency in the Haryana Legislative Assembly since the same year.
 
• However, on March 12, 2024, Khattar tendered his resignation from the position of Chief Minister of Haryana.
